title: SimulSense: Sense-Driven Interpreting for Efficient Simultaneous Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2509.21932v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How to make human-interpreter-like read/write decisions for simultaneous speech translation (SimulST) systems? Current state-of-the-art systems formulate SimulST as a multi-turn dialogue task, requiring specialized interleaved training data and relying on computationally expensive large language model (LLM) inference for decision-making. In this paper, we propose SimulSense, a novel framework for SimulST that mimics human interpreters by continuously reading input speech and triggering write decisions to produce translation when a new sense unit is perceived. Experiments against two state-of-the-art baseline systems demonstrate that our proposed method achieves a superior quality-latency tradeoff and substantially improved real-time efficiency, where its decision-making is up to 9.6x faster than the baselines.

translated_title: SimulSense：语义单元驱动的口译方法，实现高效同声语音翻译
translated_abstract: 同声语音翻译（SimulST）系统如何做出类似人类口译员的读/写决策？当前最先进的系统将SimulST构建为多轮对话任务，这需要专门的交错式训练数据，并依赖计算成本高昂的大语言模型（LLM）推理来进行决策。在本文中，我们提出了SimulSense，这是一种新颖的SimulST框架，它通过持续读取输入语音，并在感知到新的语义单元时触发写入决策以生成翻译，从而模拟人类口译员的工作方式。针对两个最先进基线系统的实验表明，我们提出的方法实现了更优的质量-延迟权衡，并显著提升了实时效率，其决策速度比基线系统快达9.6倍。
tldr: 提出SimulSense框架，通过模拟人类口译员持续读取输入语音并在感知到新语义单元时触发翻译输出，实现了更优的质量-延迟权衡，且决策速度比现有最先进基线快达9.6倍。
en_tdlr: SimulSense is a novel SimulST framework that mimics human interpreters by continuously reading input speech and triggering translation when a new sense unit is perceived, achieving a superior quality-latency tradeoff with decision-making up to 9.6x faster than state-of-the-art baselines.
